titles.eyebrow: Tour Eiffel to the Musée d'Orsay
titles.head: The Batobus
titles.text: The river is held at 26.9 m above the sea, the zero of every height in the model.

titles.eyebrow: Île de la Cité, from the Île Saint-Louis
titles.head: Notre-Dame de Paris
titles.text: Its spire stands 96 m again, rebuilt to Viollet-le-Duc's design; the cathedral reopened in December 2024.

titles.head: The Eiffel Tower
titles.text: 330 m to the tip of its antenna, its floors at 57.6, 115.7 and 276.1 m.

titles.head: Walk it
titles.text: Read the roofs with a surveyor's lens, ride the Batobus, fly under the Eiffel Tower.
